result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a few elements appear visually clipped or obscured, especially near the right edge and behind the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the content. The second card in the “Popular right now” section is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar, making the image/card feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so the last visible cards are not covered by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable items are visibly clipped at the right edge, including the category pill after “Healthy” and the restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel. This may be intentional, but it looks abrupt without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding, a fade/gradient edge, or ensure partial items are clipped more deliberately to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The restaurant name on the right side of the “Fastest near you” row is truncated by the screen edge, showing only “Trattoria Picco…”.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have enough width and spacing, or keep text fully inside the visible card area when partially displayed.
